chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Bakr ibn Muhammad, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
It is desirable (recommended) to wear a ring with a ruby.

key_terms.التَّخَتُّمُ: Wearing a ring (specifically on the finger)
key_terms.يُسْتَحَبُّ: Recommended or desirable act in Islamic jurisprudence

ai.seo_question: What is the recommended gemstone for a ring in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi highlights the preference for wearing a ruby ring, a practice deeply rooted in the customs of the Ahl al-Bayt and early Islamic society. It reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on dignified personal adornment as an expression of inner purity and social etiquette, distinguishing it from mere vanity. The recommendation underscores the balance between modesty and the appreciation of beauty within the framework of fiqh al-a'immah.
